title: Concept: pip cache disabled
description: pip.conf declares a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pip.conf (pypi).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact.
